sources.label: Independent accountant AUP report for Rupiah Token collateral - January 31, 2026

reserveReview.rationale: The January 31, 2026 independent accountant AUP report reconciles Rp94,232,212,766 of bank collateral to the total issued Rupiah Token amount and reports a 1:1 ratio. The procedures compared bank statements and time-deposit certificates, but the report does not publish the bank-level or account-type allocation.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Independent accountant agreed-upon procedures over Rupiah Token bank collateral as of January 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The aggregate bank collateral is evidenced, but the bank identities, account balances, time-deposit share, maturity terms, and legal custody safeguards are undisclosed.
